headline: Market closed for weekend; Nifty and Sensex outlook focused on geopolitical risks, crude oil, and earnings next week.

marketStatus.message: Market is closed today because it is a weekend. It will reopen on Monday, 2 November.

why: Geopolitical risks and crude oil prices above $116 steer market sentiment ahead of the new week.
Net GST collections rose 25.6% to ₹2.03 trillion, marking the fastest growth in FY27.
Foreign fund inflows and positive corporate cues supported last week's market rally of up to 2%.
Investors are tracking global cues from Wall Street and GIFT Nifty for direction in the coming sessions.
whatHappening: Indian equity markets are closed today, Sunday, November 1, 2026, for the weekend.
Tata Motors posted strong October performance with PV sales up 23% and CV sales up 27%.
Reliance Industries witnessed buying interest alongside foreign inflows during recent trading sessions.
Adani Ports surged 4% in previous trading while Sensex jumped 600 points.
summary:
Indian stock markets are closed today for the weekend and will reopen on Monday, November 2.
Over the recent sessions, markets rallied up to 2% backed by Reliance buying, Adani Ports gains, and robust October sales from Tata Motors.
Key focus for the upcoming week remains on geopolitical developments, crude oil movement, GST growth metrics, and quarterly earnings ahead of Diwali.
